Regression probe for the owner-fallback masquerade (member-source-state-conflation). At the pre-fix HEAD, renaming shellTone produced FOUR edits including two OVERLAPPING template edits: the receiver token 512..521 AND the whole shellTone.label expression 512..527, which would have destroyed the .label member access - a confident-wrong workspace edit answered as available/complete. VERDICT 2026-07-07: 3 clean edits, .label survives (${theme.label}). Root cause of the pre-fix corruption: the owner-fallback wrote the owner declaration into the member-source slot and the state rule granted source, so the shellTone.label row span-matched the shellTone declaration; fix introduced observedMemberSourceRoute (member-declaration vs owner-value) and the reference context requires member-declaration routes.
